session_summary: As the Explorer & Collector persona, I completed the Gloomwood Hollow route, gathered 25 coins upon completion, and successfully purchased and equipped the Trail Cap cosmetic from the marketplace, leaving a final coin balance of 88.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow and collected Gloomcap/Root Relic theme items, but lacked an in-game ledger or tracker for collected items.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize the Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI (currently listed as a P1 backlog item) so collectors can easily track completion progress.

observations.evidence: Purchased 'trail_cap' successfully for 45 coins, leaving 88 coins; the cosmetics store offers 7 total items to collect.
observations.recommendation: Introduce additional mid-tier cosmetic variations or color tints to give collectors frequent intermediate goals between major hat purchases.

observations.evidence: World state features the Ember Forge route with a temporary coin bonus experiment and Magma Vent Pressure content modifier.
observations.recommendation: Continue utilizing route-specific modifiers and coin bonus experiments to incentivize revisiting older routes like Moss Trail and Ember Forge.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery & Collection Milestones Ledger
feature_requests.player_value: Provides clear goals and tracking for completionists who want to 100% every route's unique item pool.
feature_requests.rationale: As an explorer, knowing which collectibles or secrets remain unvisited on routes like Gloomwood Hollow or Moon Shrine drives long-term engagement.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an in-game menu interface tracking discovered route items, completion counts, and collection milestone rewards.

keep: Rewarding route completion with direct coin payouts that allow quick initial cosmetic purchases like the Trail Cap.
Dynamic route modifiers like Magma Vent Pressure that add variety and encourage mastery of specific environments.
Diverse route themes and themed collectible lists (e.g., Gloomcap, Root Relic) that appeal directly to collection-oriented players.
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
